newsitem.title: CHINA: Wah Lee places 9.7 pct stake to China EB.
newsitem.headline: Wah Lee places 9.7 pct stake to China EB.

text.p: Wah Lee Resources Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to place 30 million new shares, or 9.68 percent of its enlarged share capital, with China Everbright Financial Holdings Ltd at HK$1.55 each.
Third party investor China Everbright Financial, a wholly owned unit China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, does not hold any Wah Lee shares prior to the deal, the statement said.
China Everbright Financial has told the company that it would not dispose more than 14 million of the shares within a period of six months from the date of completion of the agreement, Wah Lee said.

Wah Lee said the HK$46 million proceeds would be used to increase the company's stockholding of consumer electrical products which would be distributed to 98 outlets that are operated by a unit of China Travel Service Corp.
Wah Lee shares gained HK$0.025 to HK$3.40 in early trade on Monday.
